legend: A permutation of size N$$$N$$$ is an array containing distinct values between [1,N]$$$[1, N]$$$.
Define the score of a permutation P$$$P$$$ of size n$$$n$$$ as the sum of the number of divisors for every P[i]$$$P[i]$$$ that appear strictly before it in the permutation, more formally:
For example, the score of permutation {2,1,3,4}$$$\{2,1,3,4\}$$$ is 3$$$3$$$.
Your task is to find the sum of scores for all permutations of size n.
Since the answer might be very large, output it modulo 109+7$$${10}^9+7$$$.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤105$$$1 \le T \le 10^5$$$). Description of the test cases follows.
Each of the following T$$$T$$$ lines contains a single integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105$$$1\le{N}\le{10}^5$$$), the size of the permutations.
output: For each test case, print in one line the total sum of scores of all permutations in this test case module 1000000007$$$1\,000\,000\,007$$$.

legend.ai: 大小为 N$$$N$$$ 的排列是一个数组，其中包含 [1,N]$$$[1, N]$$$ 之间的互不相同的值。
定义一个大小为 n$$$n$$$ 的排列 P$$$P$$$ 的得分为：对于排列中每个 P[i]$$$P[i]$$$，统计严格出现在它之前的元素中其约数的数量，并将这些数量求和，更形式化地表示为：
你的任务是求所有大小为 n 的排列的分数之和。
由于答案可能非常大，请输出其对 109+7$$${10}^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。
